attributes.name: can_compare_ab
attributes.doc: Returns true if the Device has the capability to AB compare.

attributes.name: can_have_chains
attributes.doc: Returns true if the device is a rack.

attributes.name: can_have_drum_pads
attributes.doc: Returns true if the device is a drum rack.

attributes.name: class_display_name
attributes.doc: Return const access to the name of the device's class name as displayed in Live's browser and device chain

attributes.name: class_name
attributes.doc: Return const access to the name of the device's class.

attributes.name: filter_routing
attributes.doc: Return the current filter routing.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.doc: Return const access to whether this device is active. This will be false bothwhen the device is off and when it's inside a rack device which is off.

attributes.name: is_using_compare_preset_b
attributes.doc: Returns whether the Device has loaded the preset in compare slot B. Only relevant if can_compare_ab, otherwise errors.

attributes.name: latency_in_ms
attributes.doc: Returns the latency of the device in ms.

attributes.name: latency_in_samples
attributes.doc: Returns the latency of the device in samples.

attributes.name: mono_poly
attributes.doc: Return the current voicing mode.

attributes.name: name
attributes.doc: Return access to the name of the device.

attributes.name: oscillator_1_effect_mode
attributes.doc: Return the current effect mode of the oscillator 1.

attributes.name: oscillator_1_wavetable_category
attributes.doc: Return the current wavetable category of the oscillator 1.

attributes.name: oscillator_1_wavetable_index
attributes.doc: Return the current wavetable index of the oscillator 1.

attributes.name: oscillator_1_wavetables
attributes.doc: Get a vector of oscillator 1's wavetable names.

attributes.name: oscillator_2_effect_mode
attributes.doc: Return the current effect mode of the oscillator 2.

attributes.name: oscillator_2_wavetable_category
attributes.doc: Return the current wavetable category of the oscillator 2.

attributes.name: oscillator_2_wavetable_index
attributes.doc: Return the current wavetable index of the oscillator 2.

attributes.name: oscillator_2_wavetables
attributes.doc: Get a vector of oscillator 2's wavetable names.

attributes.name: oscillator_wavetable_categories
attributes.doc: Get a vector of the available wavetable categories.

attributes.name: poly_voices
attributes.doc: Return the current number of polyphonic voices. Uses the VoiceCount enumeration.

attributes.name: type
attributes.doc: Return the type of the device.

attributes.name: unison_mode
attributes.doc: Return the current unison mode.

attributes.name: unison_voice_count
attributes.doc: Return the current number of unison voices.

attributes.name: visible_modulation_target_names
attributes.doc: Get the names of all the visible modulation targets.
